measured.note: A real p95 over a stated sample set. The pre-lane check was a MEAN over 40 compared against this budget and reported as a p95; the substitution was named as a limitation in KNOWN-GAPS.json for three waves instead of being fixed.

limitations: A usage link opens the index-stored CALL SITE when brain_relationship.line_number holds a real line, and the referencing symbol's DECLARATION when it does not — every such row states which, in its own label and in the usages header. The store carries no call-site BYTE COLUMN, so a call-site link opens at character 0: the line is exact, the column is not stored.
A hover renders at most 3 usage links plus a "+N more" link, so a symbol with many callers shows three of them on the card and the rest through the hub.
No editor leg: this file proves the server surface. Link clicking in a real session is the E5-pattern session at H2 acceptance.
